name: thermos
description: Thermo-nuclear branch review: a deep correctness and security audit plus a harsh code-quality rubric, run as two parallel subagents and merged into one verdict. Port of Cursor's thermos plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Thermo-nuclear branch review with two parallel reviewer subagents
interface.longDescription: Thermos reviews a branch twice in parallel: a deep audit for bugs, breaking changes, security issues, devex regressions, and feature-flag leaks, and a harsh maintainability audit for structure, file growth, and spaghetti. It then merges both into one deduplicated verdict. Run it with $thermos:thermos, or run either rubric alone.
